messages:
Maya P: Heads up — biscuit stash down to two packs. Who's up for a quick shop run? :eyes:
Kevin L: I can swing by around 3pm. Any requests?
Olivia R: Oatmeal biscuits + something gluten-free if possible. :pleading_face:
Samir: Also, the big thermos on the counter has a cracked lid. Can we tag broken stuff?
Maya P: Good call. Can we start a sticker system? Green = good, yellow = use-with-care, red = toss.
Kevin L: Love it. Suggestion: put stickers on lids so we don't mix mugs.
Olivia R: Quick fridge-label format for shelf owners:
```
Shelf: Name
Date stocked: YYYY-MM-DD
Expires: YYYY-MM-DD or 'n/a'
```
Samir: I'll make the labels and a little pegboard for utensils tonight. Where should I put it? Near the kettle?
Maya P: Next to the kettle is perfect. Also can you add a 'Volunteer coffee patrol' sign-up — 1 person/week.
PantryBot: (automated) 2 packs of original biscuits ordered — delivery ETA tomorrow 11:30am. :truck:
Kevin L: Sweet. If someone brings a thermos, please put a green sticker on it after testing the lid. Last week's leak was a tragedy. :sweat_smile:
Olivia R: Poll — who wants salted caramel and which wants cinnamon? React with :salt: for caramel, :cinnamon: for cinnamon.
Samir: :salt:
Maya P: :cinnamon:
Kevin L: :salt:
Olivia R: Thanks all — I'll pin the sticker legend and fridge-label template in #lunch-plans. If anyone wants to join the grocery run, meet me at reception at 2:45. :shopping_trolley:
